description: The camera stands on the travertine pavement of Piazza del Popolo, taking in the Renaissance square under a cloudy 07:53 morning sky. The crenellated Palazzo dei Capitani rises at center with its tall tower, the arcaded facade of a Renaissance palazzo runs along the left, and the pale stone flank of the church with its rose window fills the right. The vast stone square lies empty, its pale slabs catching the soft diffused daylight.
